entries.feedback: First live run (collaborator Word draft with tracked changes, shared Drive link): the skill had to test the author's original text, find the file fast, and not mistake checker errors for fabricated references
entries.change: extract_text.py --original (tracked changes), DOCX tables kept in order and out of the reference list, 'Reference' heading; drive_intake.py Spotlight lookup; check_references.py rejoins DOIs split by a space and unescapes HTML in titles; grade.py weak headline no longer blames style

entries.feedback: Not happy with the designed report: wants it very raw (plain HTML), the document's text with only AI-looking parts highlighted, and the scores as the most important part
entries.change: report_raw.py is the default report (scores table with thresholds and held-out error rates, per-window table, text with shaded windows and marked words/phrases/artefacts); stylometry.py records phrase spans and exact window offsets; calibrate.py stores held-out rates

entries.feedback: Don't use downloaded models; use a compendium of web detectors instead
entries.change: detect_models.py and local Binoculars/Fast-DetectGPT removed; setup_env.sh is a small env (pymupdf, python-docx, playwright); web_detectors.json v2 with 11 tools and a consensus row; grading, report, ledger, baseline and calibration updated

entries.feedback: Work on the artifact: chunks are fine but choose them wisely and make them clear; everything must be much more intuitive
entries.change: passages = whole prose paragraphs within one section (title page, affiliations, captions never sent); report organised by passage: answer + facts, coloured passages table with agreement, text passage by passage with headers, marked sentences shaded by number of tools

entries.feedback: Report not clear whether it is AI slop; wants brighter colours and a cleaner layout, like the web detectors
entries.change: report_raw.py follows web-detector layout: headline share of AI-like prose (ring + breakdown bar), verdict pill, checks, highlighted text with human text plain, side panel of per-passage and per-detector scores

entries.feedback: Replace the rule that combines detectors (mean x sqrt(k) lowered the result whenever a detector was added)
entries.change: evidence.py adds each detector's evidence divided by the overlap the others carry (score correlation within class on known texts, weighted by informativeness; full overlap assumed where unmeasurable). Specified and its validation fixed before applying it to the case; grading bars unchanged. On known texts no human text reaches 3x; 7/10 AI reach 10x.
